notes: Grab operates in eight countries: the 20-F defines "Southeast Asia" as Cambodia, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam, with local offices in each. A list of countries with no figures is not a footprint row, so Cambodia and Myanmar have no rows. The 20-F gives employees only by function (11,267 full-time at Dec 31, 2024) and partner earnings only in total ($12.8 billion earned by driver- and merchant-partners in 2024); the 2024 ESG report gives employee gender split by country (including China, India and Romania) but no headcounts. Revenue by country exists in the 20-F but is already in the records. The only non-revenue country figures are loan receivables (credit exposure) for six markets, recorded as countries rows. Leased offices total over 107,700 sq m. The 20-F PDF is hosted on Grab's investor-relations CDN (q4cdn), hostType company.
